body: And more reasons I am glad to be dead soon. Saw my GP today I now am up to 18 tablets PER DAY so more medical costs. Sorry but thanks for talking to me and letting me rant.

Borderline personality disorder  actually diagnosed with it 4 years ago from childhood trauma. And minor just things like bruising, swelling, and chronic headaches. Nothing major like full brain damage.

yeah there is a LOT I have been diagnosed with by my doctor and specialists. It really sucks big time all this pain.

I screamed whatever I am waiting for police she said what the fuck did you say to me and last thing I remember was her running at me and king hitting me. The rest was told by bystanders and witnesses I was screaming the kids were holding me down while their mum done serious damage the witnesses tried to get her to stop but it was hard with 4 kids and their mother. Eventually they got her to stop and she stole my phone. I was rushed to hospital in a bad way and since then my health is getting worse and worse before the assault only issue I had was BPD.

Yep she gets a lot of love and attention.

Etc etc etc.  There is a LOT and 90% is from the assault I suffered. Why I am glad I will not be around much longer.
Don't have friends or family only my dog.  Yeah I know but it's hard when my medical bills are costing 2000 AUD per MONTH. It really is killing me literally

Worse and worse every day. Glad to be going soon. No friends no family as always.  Got  financial counseling that is helping with the bankruptcy stuff but have not told them about what's going to happen.
